import sys

for line in sys.stdin:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    parts = line.split()
    if len(parts) < 2:
        continue
    n = int(parts[0])
    s = parts[1]
    inside_parentheses = False
    word_nok = True
    one_count = 0
    max_substring = ""
    current_substring = ""
    for c in range(n):
        ch = s[c]
        if ch == '(':
            inside_parentheses = True
            word_nok = True
            current_substring = ""
        elif ch == ')':
            inside_parentheses = False
            current_substring = ""
        else:
            if not inside_parentheses:
                if ch == '_':
                    current_substring = ""
                else:
                    current_substring += ch
                if len(current_substring) > len(max_substring):
                    max_substring = current_substring
            else:
                if ch == '_':
                    word_nok = True
                else:
                    if word_nok:
                        one_count += 1
                        word_nok = False
    print(f"{len(max_substring)} {one_count}")
